blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The Balay Mindanaw Foundation, Inc. (BMFI), a Mindanao-based non-government organization (NGO), joined other peace groups on the island in celebrating the annual Mindanao Week of Peace, which kicked off on Thursday, Nov. 26. “We affirm our belief that peace begins with people. Every bridge we build, every divide we cross, and every act of solidarity brings us closer to the peace we seek,” Karlos Manlupig, Balay Mindanaw executive director, said in a statement as the region begins activities related to peace-building.
